status: Prospective amendment for new executions; screening completion is explicitly post hoc because the candidate search and earlier cases already exist.
objectives: Account for every one of the 87 unique records in the frozen six-search retrieval, without relabeling it an exhaustive literature or ecosystem search.
Execute a source-backed contrasting case in which retaining data for an application artifact is the intended and successful repair, not automatically a model-delivery failure.
Reassess whether the claimed empirical increment survives the completed screening and negative/qualified evidence.

screening.unit: Unique public issue URL; duplicate search hits retain all query memberships.
screening.first_stage: Inspect title, project and creation date. Clearly non-Model-Context-Protocol software and feature/protocol proposals with no result-transformation incident can be excluded here; do not claim full-body reading for those records.
screening.second_stage: Read full retained issue body for uncertain or directly relevant records. Retain unclear recipient, unresolved report and intended policy as separate statuses; a reporter's allegation is not verification.
screening.deepening: Fetch discussion/linked merged repair only for relevant records. Report coverage separately from title/body screening. Do not label all retained candidates confirmed defects.
screening.source_of_bias: Original query terms, chronological first-page cap, comment-inclusive GitHub matching, Python executability and researcher judgment. Completing screening does not fix retrieval bias.
screening.coding: Independent human case review has not been completed.

contrasting_execution.requirement: Structured data available to the application artifact; distinguish that requirement from model-bound text. Original tests and public documentation establish intended recipient.
contrasting_execution.design: Pin parent and merged revision. Run unchanged conversion/tool code with native MCP and LangChain message types as feasible, and retain exact substitutions and observation boundary. Check structured-only, complementary summary, full serialized fallback and unsupported representation handling.
contrasting_execution.failure_rule: If imports or dependency matching fail, retain source-only evidence; do not silently replace the converter with a reimplementation.
contrasting_execution.not_claimed: No production frequency, whole-application replay, new defect or LLM accuracy.
